tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new joint taxable advisory account opening package for Nolan Pebblefizz and Lila Pebblefizz. Confirm account purpose, transfer-on-death registration, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete. The account is for cash above the $120,000 household reserve target and anticipated estate cash, and its profile should reflect a moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and a preference to avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to proceed with the account-opening work by 2024-11-01.

tickets.title: Prepare Year-End Tax Projection and Charitable Analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a year-end tax projection for Nolan Pebblefizz and Lila Pebblefizz coordinating withholding, estimated tax exposure, and appreciated-share giving, and analyze whether a larger charitable gift should be made before year-end alongside their roughly $18,000 of annual giving to Silver Marmot Arts Fund.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the year-end tax projection and charitable funding analysis by 2024-12-06.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect the core facts needed to evaluate an inheritance event for Nolan Pebblefizz following the death of his mother Adele Pebblefizz in August 2024, including the expected asset types, estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Do not request sensitive account numbers unless required through secure channels. The executor informally estimated about $220,000 in cash plus a fractional inherited IRA interest, and the file still needs the estate inventory, beneficiary confirmation, inherited IRA custodian notice, and expected distribution schedule.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate by 2024-10-30.

tickets.title: Reconcile Paper Otter Analytics Stock Basis
tickets.text: Reconcile the cost basis for the Paper Otter Analytics tax lots in the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable brokerage account against the unrealized gain report, since the discrepancy affects which shares are suitable for charitable gifting or trimming.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the Paper Otter Analytics stock basis by 2024-11-08.

tickets.title: Confirm and Correct Velvet Acorn Custody Records
tickets.text: Confirm current records and correct account-level settings for Nolan Pebblefizz and Lila Pebblefizz at Velvet Acorn Custody, including the household login still set to paper delivery and the IRA beneficiary update that is not displaying.
tickets.evidence: The service follow-up is limited to confirming current records and correcting account-level settings where needed, and they agreed to address it by 2024-10-23.

tickets.title: Prepare Estate Document Coordination Points
tickets.text: Prepare coordination points for the estate attorney to review the Pebblefizz estate documents, which still reference guardianship provisions from when the children were minors and name a successor trustee who has moved overseas.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare the estate document coordination points by 2024-11-15.
